mapper.select: SELECT a.finprod_id as finprodId, a.finprod_name as finprodName, to_char(a.val_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS valDateString, a.val_bal_flag as valBalFlag, b2.file_id as fileId, b2.file_type as fileType, b2.file_name as fileName, b2.file_path as filePath FROM BOK_VALBAL_TABLE_STATUS a INNER JOIN BOK_VALBAL_TABLE_FILE b ON a.finprod_id = b.finprod_id AND a.val_date = b.val_date AND a.val_bal_flag = b.val_bal_flag INNER JOIN BOK_FILE_INFO b2 ON b.file_id = b2.file_id AND b.File_Type = b2.file_type WHERE a.finprod_id = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND a.val_date = to_date(#{valDateString,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-mm-dd') and a.val_bal_flag = #{valBalFlag,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND b.file_type = #{fileType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT c.sch_id schemeId, c.sch_name schemeName, c.scheme_type schemeType, b.bookset_id booksetId, c.is_default isdefaule, d.ERROR_NUMBER errorNumber, d.MY_START_ROW_NO myStartRowNo, d.OTHERSIDE_START_ROW_NO othersideStartRowNo, d.MY_END_ROW_NO myEndRowNo, d.OTHERSIDE_END_ROW_NO othersideEndRowNo FROM BOK_BOOKSET a INNER JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_PLAN b ON a.BOOKSET_ID = b.bookset_id INNER JOIN BOK_SCHEME_INFO c ON c.sch_id = b.scheme_id and c.scheme_type = b.scheme_type INNER JOIN BOK_SCHEME_INFO_DETAIL d ON d.sch_id = c.sch_id where a.acct_subject_id = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and c.scheme_type = #{schemeType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT c.sch_id schemeId, c.sch_name schemeName, c.scheme_type schemeType, b.bookset_id booksetId, c.is_default isdefaule, d.ERROR_NUMBER errorNumber, d.MY_START_ROW_NO myStartRowNo, d.OTHERSIDE_START_ROW_NO othersideStartRowNo, d.MY_END_ROW_NO myEndRowNo, d.OTHERSIDE_END_ROW_NO othersideEndRowNo FROM BOK_BOOKSET a INNER JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_PLAN b ON a.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL = b.bookset_id INNER JOIN BOK_SCHEME_INFO c ON c.sch_id = b.scheme_id and c.scheme_type = b.scheme_type INNER JOIN BOK_SCHEME_INFO_DETAIL d ON d.sch_id = c.sch_id where a.acct_subject_id = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and nvl(c.is_default,'N') = 'Y' and c.scheme_type = #{schemeType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT a.SEQ_NO seqNo, a.SCHEME_ID schemeId, a.BLOCK_TYPE blockType, a.MY_COL_ID myColId,
a.MY_COL_REMARK myColRemark, a.OTHERSIDE_COL_ID othersideColId, a.OTHERSIDE_COL_REMARK othersideColRemark FROM BOK_SCHEME_STRUCT_CONFIG a INNER JOIN BOK_SCHEME_INFO info on info.sch_id = a.scheme_id WHERE a.SCHEME_ID = #{schemeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
